contexts.1440: 1440x900, deviceScaleFactor 1, mouse (pointer fine, hover), color scheme dark, motion allowed
contexts.390: 390x844, deviceScaleFactor 2, isMobile, touch (pointer coarse, hover none), color scheme dark, motion allowed

per unit.<unit>.aria.yml: Playwright ariaSnapshot of the unit's element
per unit.<unit>.controls.txt: every control from Chromium's accessibility tree, one per line: role, name, value, states (checked, pressed, selected, expanded, disabled, level, orientation, live, atomic, controls, describedby and others), url, focusable, element and tab index
per unit.<unit>.controls.json: the same with every accessibility property and the element's ARIA attributes and page box
per unit.<unit>.png: the unit's box, device pixels, stitched from viewport captures, fixed header hidden (header.png shows the header over the top of the page)

per width.first-viewport.png: the first viewport as a visitor lands (1.6 s after load)
per width.full-page.png: the whole page, header only where it sits at load
per width.skip-link-focused.png: the skip link on the first Tab
per width.page.json: title, meta description, html attributes, landmarks, headings, skip links, body and main children, media features
per width.geometry.json: document height and every unit's top and height
per width.nav-states.json: the header's computed background and rule at scroll 0, 24, 48, 72, 96, 200, 900, mid page and the end
per width.tab-order.txt, tab-order.json: a real Tab walk from load: every stop with role, name, unit, focus-visible, under-header and on-screen checks (44 stops at 1440, 39 at 390; none under the header, none off screen)
per width.390 only: menu-open.txt, .aria.yml, .con: the open menu and how it closes: Escape (focus back on Menu), outside press, link choice (lands at #how-it-works, top 80 below the 65 px header) and Tab away (after 7 presses); the toggle is 70x44 and each link 206x47 on touch
